nodes.name: Theorem 1.2, Lemma 3.1, Lemma 3.4, Lemma 3.5, Theorem 3.9: *+[F] Special cases $^{(\star)}$ of
nodes.statement:
Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ be a DCC set. Then there exists a positive integer $l$ depending only on ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following. Assume that $(X\ni x,B)$ is a threefold pair such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in{\Gamma}$, and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)\geq 1$. Then there exists a prime divisor $E$ over $X\ni x$, such that $a(E,X,B)={\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)$ and $a(E,X,0)\leq l$.

Let $I$ be a positive integer, $\alpha \geq 1$ a real number,  and ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ a DCC set. Then there exists a positive integer $l$ depending only on $I,\alpha$ and ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following. Assume that
\begin{enumerate}
    \item $(X\ni x,B:=\sum_{i} b_iB_i')$ is a threefold germ,
    \item $X$ is terminal,
    \item each $b_i\in{\Gamma}$ and each $B_i'\geq 0$ is a $\mathbb{Q}$-Cartier Weil divisor,
    \item ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)= \alpha$,
    \item $IK_X$ is Cartier near $x$, and
    \item there exists a terminal blow-up (see Definition~2.34) $f: Y\rightarrow X$ of $(X\ni x,B)$.
\end{enumerate}
Then there exists a prime divisor $E$ over $X\ni x$, such that $a(E,X,B)={\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)$ and $a(E,X,0)=1+\frac{a}{I}$ for some positive integer $a\leq l$.

Let $(X\ni x, B)$ be a threefold germ such that $X$ is smooth and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x, B)\geq 1$. Then there exists a terminal blow-up (see Definition~2.34) $f: Y\to X$ of $(X\ni x,B)$, such that $Y$ is $\mathbb{Q}$-factorial.

Let $x\in X$ be a threefold terminal singularity of type $cA/n$. Then there exists a Cartier divisor $C$ near $x$ satisfying the following.

Let $(X\ni x, B)$ be a pair such that ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x, B)\geq 1$. Then there exists a terminal blow-up of $(X\ni x, B)$ (see Definition~2.34) which extracts a prime divisor $E$ over $X\ni x$, such that $a(E,X,B+tC)=1$ and $\operatorname{mult}_E C=1$, where $t:=\operatorname{ct}(X\ni x, B;C)$.

Let ${\Gamma} \subset [0,1]$ be a DCC set. Then there exists a positive integer $l$ depending only on ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following.

Let $(X\ni x,B)$ be a threefold pair such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in {\Gamma}$, and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)=1$. Then there exists a prime divisor $E$ over $X\ni x$, such that $a(E,X,B)=1$ and $a(E,X,0)\le 1+\frac{l}{I}$, where $I$ is the index of $X\ni x$. In particular,  $a(E,X,0)\le 1+l$.
labels: lem: bounded index Mustata nakamura conjecture
lem: can extract mld place smooth case
lem: can extract mld place cA/n case

nodes.name: Theorem 1.7, Theorem 3.11: *+[F] ACC for cts
nodes.statement:
Let ${\Gamma}\subset[0,1]$ and ${\Gamma}'\subset[0,+\infty)$ be two DCC sets. Then the set
$$\operatorname{CT}(3,{\Gamma},{\Gamma}'):=\{\operatorname{ct}(X,B;D)\mid\dim X=3, B\in {\Gamma},D\in{\Gamma}'\}$$
satisfies the ACC.

Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1],~{\Gamma}'\subset [0,+\infty)$ be two DCC sets. Then the set 
$$\{\operatorname{ct}(X\ni x, B;D)\mid \dim X=3,~X \text{ is terminal},~B\in {\Gamma},~D\in {\Gamma}'\}$$
satisfies the ACC.
labels: thm: ACC ct local with base terminal

nodes.name: Theorem 1.8: *+[F] Accumulation points
nodes.statement: The set of accumulation points of $\operatorname{CT}(3,\{0\},\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 1})$ is $\{0\}\cup\{\frac{1}{m}\mid m\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 2}\}$.

nodes.name: Theorem 6.1: *+[F] $1$ -gap for mlds
nodes.statement: Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ be a DCC set. Then $1$ is not an accumulation point of $$\{{\rm{mld}}(X,B)\mid \dim X=3,B\in{\Gamma}\}$$ from below.

nodes.name: Theorem 1.1, Theorem 4.1, Theorem 1.6: *+[F] ACC for mlds $^{(\dagger)}$ ACC for $a$ -lcts
nodes.statement:
Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ be a DCC set. Then there exists a positive real number $\delta$ depending only on ${\Gamma}$, such that 
$$\{{\rm{mld}}(X,B)\mid \dim X=3, B\in {\Gamma}\}\cap [1-\delta,+\infty)$$
satisfies the ACC, where $B\in{\Gamma}$ means that the coefficients of $B$ belong to the set ${\Gamma}$.

Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ be a DCC set. Then the set
$$\{{\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)\mid \dim X=3, X\text{ is terminal near $x$},B\in{\Gamma}\}\cap [1,+\infty)$$
satisfies the ACC.

Let $a\geq 1$ be a real number, and ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1],~{\Gamma}'\subset [0,+\infty)$ two DCC sets. Then the set of $a$-lc thresholds,
   $$\{a\text{-}\operatorname{lct}(X\ni x,B;D)\mid \dim X=3, X\text{ is terminal}, B\in{\Gamma}, D\in{\Gamma}'\},$$
     satisfies the ACC.
labels: thm: intro global canonical mld acc

nodes.name: Theorem 1.9: *+[F] Log Calabi-Yau birational boundedness
nodes.statement: Let ${\Gamma}\subset[0,+\infty)$ be a DCC set. Then the set of non-canonical klt threefold log Calabi-Yau pairs $(X,B)$ with $B\in {\Gamma}$ forms a bounded family modulo flops.
labels: thm: non-canonical klt CY threefold bdd flop

nodes.name: Theorem 1.5, Theorem 5.7: *+[F] Index conjecture
nodes.statement:
Let $\epsilon\geq 1$ be a real number and ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]\cap\mathbb{Q}$ a DCC set. Then there exists a positive integer $I$ depending only on $\epsilon$ and ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following. 

Let $(X\ni x, B)$ be a threefold pair such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in{\Gamma}$, and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)=\epsilon$. Then $I(K_X+B)$ is Cartier near $x$.

Let $\Gamma\subset[0,1]$ be a set and $m$ a positive integer such that $m\Gamma\subset \mathbb{Z}$. Then the positive integer $N:=12m^2$ satisfies the following.

Let $(X\ni x, B)$ be a threefold germ such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in {\Gamma}$, and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x, B)=1$. Then $I(K_X+B)$ is Cartier near $x$ for some positive integer $I\le N$.

nodes.name: Theorem 1.3, Theorem 1.4: *+[F] General elephants $^{(\dagger)}$ local complements $^{(\ddagger)}$
nodes.statement:
Let ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]\cap\mathbb{Q}$ be a finite set. Then there exists a positive integer $N$ depending only on ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following.

Let $(X\ni x,B)$ be a threefold pair such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in{\Gamma}$, and $(X,B)$ is canonical near $x$. Then on a neighborhood of $x$, there exists an element $G\in |-N(K_X+B)|$ such that $(X,B+\frac{1}{N}G)$ is canonical near $x$.

Let $\epsilon\geq 1$ be a real number and ${\Gamma}\subset [0,1]$ a DCC set. Then there exists a positive integer $N$ depending only on $\epsilon$ and ${\Gamma}$ satisfying the following. 

Assume that $(X\ni x,B)$ is a threefold pair, such that $X$ is terminal, $B\in{\Gamma}$, and ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B)\geq\epsilon$. Then there exists an $N$-complement  $(X\ni x,B^+)$ of $(X\ni x,B)$ such that ${\rm{mld}}(X\ni x,B^+)\geq\epsilon$.
